title: TanzoGlyph Blockchain Metadata Schema
description: Schema definition for blockchain metadata related to TanzoGlyph registrations

ipfs_cid.description: IPFS Content ID for the TanzoGlyph profile

verification_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash for blockchain verification of this glyph

tanzolang_version.description: Version of TanzoLang used for encoding

lineage_root_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash for the lineage root of this identity

issuer_pubkey.description: Public key of the issuing entity

signature.description: Cryptographic signature of the glyph content

expiration.description: Expiration date of this verification (if applicable)

registry_url.description: URL to the registry where this glyph is registered

derivation_path.description: Array of transaction hashes representing the derivation path
